# V4.2.0 Zinogre 🍝

1. macOS 与 Android 新增安全的 HTTPS Git 同步，支持手动同步、15 分钟后台同步、退出前尽力同步和逐文件冲突选择
2. 新增面向 Android 15 及更高版本的原生预览版，笔记默认保存在应用私有目录，并支持嵌套文件夹、置顶、搜索与可恢复回收站
3. Android 编辑器新增与 macOS 匹配的语法配色、主题、字体设置和流畅滚动，笔记打开时会从文档顶部开始
4. Android 使用 cmark-gfm 渲染预览，并支持本地图片与附件、全屏预览、分屏布局和逐页演示模式
5. Android 的导入导出、演示数据、语言选择和 Git 备份状态均集中在设置中，敏感凭据仅保存在系统密钥库
6. macOS 新增演示模式工具栏按钮、Git 同步菜单图标、回收站恢复与永久删除操作，并修正搜索框对齐

---

1. macOS and Android add secure HTTPS Git sync with manual sync, a 15-minute background schedule, best-effort sync on exit, and per-file conflict choices
2. A native preview for Android 15 and newer stores notes in an app-private library with nested folders, pins, search, and recoverable Trash
3. The Android editor adds macOS-matched syntax colours, themes, font settings, and smoother scrolling, and opens notes at the top
4. Android renders previews with cmark-gfm and supports local images and attachments, fullscreen preview, split layouts, and slide presentations
5. Android keeps import/export, demo data, language selection, and Git backup status in Settings, while sensitive credentials stay in the system keystore
6. macOS adds the presentation toolbar action, a Git sync menu icon, Trash restore and permanent delete actions, and corrected search-field alignment
